slides.title: I clean twice as much when a friend is on the phone. Here's why.
slides.sub: Body doubling, but make it cozy

slides.title: Someone else in the room helps
slides.body: Many of us start easier with company. They don't help clean. They're there.

slides.title: Call, don't visit
slides.body: No one has to see the mess. Put the phone on speaker and walk room to room.

slides.title: Pick one zone before you dial
slides.body: 'I'm doing the kitchen counter' keeps the call from turning into a tour.

slides.title: Set a song-length goal
slides.body: Clean for three songs on their playlist. Then you both stop and chat.

slides.title: No friend free? Try these
items: A video call with mute on

slides.title: You don't need more willpower. You might need more company.
Want more ways to start?
slides.body: It's in The Messy Brain Home Reset, our 7-day shame-free home reset. Link in bio.
